title: Strong controlling contrary authority exists
constitution: §25 deliberately search for contrary authority; §24 adverse authority is high-risk; §44 adverse authority

input.question: Can plaintiffs defeat the government contractor defense on the AFFF design claims?

expected: The contrary authority is in the local record and resolves in scope; claims that characterize adverse authority are tagged high-risk. With a model, a verification of an answer that ignores Boyle is not 'verified' once Boyle's text is in the source set.
passCriteria: resolveCitation('487 U.S. 500', AFFF scope).state === 'resolved' && ref.title matches /Boyle/
[model] verifyClaims('No controlling authority bars the design-defect claim.', [Boyle text]).status !== 'verified'
